subject.title: Feature: Graceful Gateway Restart with Session Recovery

question: Which restart-recovery scope should OpenClaw own next for #57425: durable drain-window message replay, cron interruption retry/deferral, restart readiness/config policy, or only narrower shipped defaults?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes core gateway lifecycle, persisted session state, cron semantics, config defaults, and channel delivery guarantees, which need maintainer product direction before repair automation.

options.title: Sequence narrow core fixes
options.body: Keep the umbrella open and sponsor narrower PRs for durable message replay and cron retry/deferral semantics before deciding broader readiness/config defaults.

options.title: Adopt opt-in continuation first
options.body: Treat opt-in session continuation as the first supported slice while leaving cron and drain-window replay as separate tracked work.

options.title: Defer broad recovery
options.body: Leave existing partial recovery behavior in place and close or defer broad manifest/config recovery until maintainers choose a smaller supported contract.

recommendation.title: Sequence narrow core fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella open and sponsor narrower PRs for durable message replay and cron retry/deferral semantics before deciding broader readiness/config defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and authored the merged restart-drain and cron-interruption work closest to the remaining product choices.
